title: 국립박물관 소장유물 대여 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00555:20240614:00010:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA (Enforcement Rules of the Act on Preservation and Utilization of Cultural Heritage) <No. 555, June 14, 2024>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Article 2 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations) (1) Omitted.

(2) The Rules on Lending Artifacts Held by National Museums are partially amended as follows:

The title of Article 4, "(Reporting Loans of Designated Cultural Properties, etc.)", shall be replaced with "(Reporting Loans of Designated Cultural Heritage, etc.)". In the part of Article 4 other than its title, "designated cultural property or provisionally designated cultural property under the Cultural Heritage Protection Act" shall be replaced with "designated cultural heritage or provisionally designated cultural heritage under the Act on Preservation and Utilization of Cultural Heritage, or natural monuments, etc., provisionally designated natural monuments, or provisionally designated scenic sites under the Act on Preservation and Utilization of Natural Heritage".

(3) through (5) Omitted.

Article 3 Omitted.
